Sean Ichioka behind and higher on the right: officially verified appearance from Utsunomiya Brex profile: very short dark brown buzz cut, slightly receding temples, oblong face, clearly prominent ears, straight nose, defined brows, full closely trimmed brown beard connected to moustache, narrower jaw tapering to beard-covered chin.
